name: Nutritionist / dietitian clinic
summary: How expats book nutritionist or dietitian care in Singapore — clinical vs wellness scopes, sports nutrition, and how to read credentials.
body:
Dietitians and nutritionists are not interchangeable titles everywhere — for clinical conditions, prefer regulated dietitian pathways and GP/specialist coordination. Expats often seek help for cholesterol, gestational nutrition, IBS patterns, and busy-office meal structure.

## Decision points
- Clinical dietitian vs general wellness coaching
- Condition-led care (diabetes, renal, pregnancy)
- Sports nutrition for training blocks
- Grocery / hawker-realistic meal plans
- Insurance or corporate wellness coverage

Bring recent bloodwork when relevant.

## How to choose
Ask about credentials and whether the plan is condition-specific. Prefer clinicians who work with your existing doctors. Avoid extreme detox packages sold as medical care.

## Practical tip
Photograph two weeks of real lunches before the first visit. Idealised food diaries produce useless plans.
